sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
turns: So, what kind of pets do you have?
I have a dog named Max.
That's great! What breed is Max?
Oh, I love Golden Retrievers! What's Max like as a pet?
Max is such a loving and loyal companion. He's very playful and always up for a game of fetch or a walk. He's also very protective of our family, which makes me feel safe.
Sounds like Max is a great companion. I used to have a Golden Retriever when I was younger. His name was Buddy and he was my best friend.
Oh, that's so cool! What happened to Buddy? Did he pass away?
No, we had to give him away to my grandparents when I went away to college. It was a tough decision, but I knew I wouldn't be able to give him the attention he deserved while I was in school.
That must have been a tough decision. I'm sure Buddy is happy and well taken care of with your grandparents. Do you have any other pets now?
No, just Max. He's been such a great companion and I don't think I could handle having another pet at the moment. How about you? Do you have any other pets besides Max?

No, just Max. I do love dogs, though. I grew up with a family that always had dogs, so they will always hold a special place in my heart. What about you? Do you have any other pets besides the Golden Retriever you had as a child?
No, just Max. He's been my only pet for the past few years. I do love dogs and hope to have more in the future, but for now, I'm happy with just Max.
I completely understand. Max sounds like a great pet and I'm sure he's happy with just you. Thanks for sharing about Max with me. It's always great to talk to someone who loves dogs as much as I do!
Of course, it was my pleasure! Thanks for sharing about Max with me too. I'm sure he's a great companion for you.
Thanks, I appreciate that. It was nice talking to you about our pets. Have a great day!
